stem: Which sentence from the selection suggests that the author thinks CyArk's work is important?

options.label: F
options.text: It’s difficult to imagine a more majestic American landmark than Mount Rushmore, with its imposing likenesses of former presidents carved in stone and rising dramatically above the land.

options.label: G
options.text: CyArk has documented locations across the globe.

options.label: H
options.text: CyArk’s preservation process ensures that images of such sites will be available for future generations, even if the site itself is permanently lost.

options.label: J
options.text: In 2010, Cedarleaf learned that the tombs had burned to the ground.
